chunks: Her Lord accepted her with a good acceptance, and He caused her to grow with good growth, and Zakariya was her guardian. Whenever Zakariya entered upon her in the mihrab, he found with her provision. He said: 'O Mary, from where is this to you?' She said: 'It is from Allah; indeed Allah gives provision to whom He wills without account.'
ai.seo_question: Who was Mary's guardian and how did she receive miraculous provision?
ai.summary: This verse highlights the divine acceptance of Maryam, whose upbringing under Prophet Zakariya is viewed in Shia tradition as a period of spiritual purification and preparation for her role as the mother of Isa. The miraculous provision of rizq in the mihrab serves as a sign of her elevated spiritual status, illustrating Allah's boundless generosity to the righteous. This narrative underscores the concept of divine election (ikhtiyar) and the unique sanctity accorded to Maryam among women.
